When a new Sefer Torah (five books of Moses) is completed after years of work it is carried in a big community parade to synagogue. Rabbis and leaders young and old from the Ashkenazi Nitra group take it turns to carry the decorated scrolls to their Shul on Clapton Common, Stamford Hill. Members of the community touch and kiss the scrolls as they pass.

AMF Monorail transports visitors at 1964 World's Fair, Flushing Meadow New York. The American Machine & Foundry Company designed and built the Fair's monorail system at a cost of over five million dollars. Each of the seven trains was automatically controlled, air-conditioned and played a continuous recording that described points of interest along the way. Photo by John G. Zimmerman.
